global_visual_rules: No internal file paths in audience-facing citations.
No decorative use of lit_uvlf_alpha.png as central evidence.
No interpolation, jitter, or smoothing of the 453 row-level points.
Keep row-contribution and dominant-table provenance visible; do not imply 67 independent contributing catalogues in the target slice.
Keep the no-bandpass-homogenization caveat visible; do not call the plotted catalogue fields a uniform 1500-angstrom rest-frame M_UV measurement.
Scope archive-search claims to the frozen two-channel VizieR manifest; other repositories were not exhaustively searched.
Do not approve public integration until an audience-reachable supplement supports the 453-row denominator and six-table geometry.
Keep study status explicit: human-cleared for Lab landing, but not journal-refereed, independently validated, or a journal result.
Maintain source boundaries among search reach, eligibility status, census rows, and published LF points.
Keep the raw-census caveat visible through the evidence-plane scenes.
Every numerical claim appears with its unit, threshold, slice, denominator, or status qualifier.
